title_zh: S06全龄无障碍信息服务90日最小交付包
title_en: S06 All-Ages Accessible Information Service 90-Day Minimum Delivery Package
purpose_zh: 把一条经核验的有限关键路径作为受控对象，先证明普通服务可用，再验证AI建议，最后在全部授权成立时开展限量共测；任何阶段均不得降低既有人工和非数字服务。
purpose_en: Treat one verified bounded key route as the controlled object: first establish ordinary service, then validate AI advice, and only then conduct limited co-testing if all authorisations exist. No phase may reduce existing staffed or non-digital service.
authority_boundary_zh: 本包是供后续依法确定的专业团队使用的预登记模板，不批准场地、服务、数据处理、参与招募、预算、采购或上线。日数表示相对工作段，不是已确定日历。
authority_boundary_en: This package is a preregistration template for future lawfully appointed professional teams. It approves no site, service, data processing, participant recruitment, budget, procurement, or launch. Day ranges are relative work periods, not a confirmed calendar.

common_controls.ordinary_service_first_zh: 固定导视、触觉与易读信息、纸质导览、电话和人工服务必须先于AI可用，并在全周期保持等价。
common_controls.ordinary_service_first_en: Fixed signs, tactile and easy-read information, paper wayfinding, telephone, and staffed service must precede AI and remain equivalent throughout.
common_controls.decision_rule_zh: AI只提供建议；路线确认、例外处理、法定决定、申诉和停止由依法确定的人员承担。
common_controls.decision_rule_en: AI provides advice only; route confirmation, exception handling, statutory decisions, appeals, and stopping remain with lawfully appointed people.
common_controls.no_penalty_rule_zh: 拒绝或关闭AI不得增加费用、不合理等待或异地行程。
common_controls.no_penalty_rule_en: Declining or disabling AI shall add no fee, unreasonable wait, or off-site journey.

phases.title_zh: 普通服务与无障碍基线
minimum_inputs_zh: 候选关键路径及开放时段
场地权利与现场核验责任
现有固定导视、纸质、电话和人工服务清单
代表性使用者参与计划
投诉、求助和紧急联系渠道
minimum_inputs_en: Candidate key route and opening hours
Inventory of existing fixed, paper, telephone, and staffed services
field_outputs_zh: 逐段开放与无障碍核查表
关键阻断和临时障碍图
普通服务路线与服务点图
人工巡检卡和更新时间记录
非AI完成率、等待、距离和费用基线
field_outputs_en: Human inspection card and update-time record
Non-AI completion, wait, distance, and cost baseline

acceptance_records.zh: IE与DO对场地、路线、服务时段和人工责任的书面接收
acceptance_records.en: Written IE and DO receipt for site, route, service hours, and human accountability

acceptance_records.zh: PO组织的代表性用户路线复核与意见回应
acceptance_records.en: PO-led representative-user route review and response

acceptance_records.zh: DC确认零AI阶段不建立持续身份轨迹
acceptance_records.en: DC confirmation that the no-AI baseline creates no persistent identity trace

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 进入下一阶段前100%关闭或提供经用户复核的等效服务
control_metrics.threshold_en: 100% closed or provided with user-reviewed equivalent service before the next phase

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 固定、纸质、电话和人工渠道按适用场景可用
control_metrics.threshold_en: Applicable fixed, paper, telephone, and staffed channels available

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 重大异议100%记录状态和回应责任
control_metrics.threshold_en: 100% of major objections record status and response accountability

stop_triggers_zh: 场地权利或路线开放状态不清
关键无障碍阻断未关闭且无等效服务
人工服务责任或班次不成立
代表性用户无法安全参与
普通服务基线无法记录
stop_triggers_en: Unclear site rights or route opening status
Critical accessibility barrier unresolved without equivalent service
exit_outputs_zh: 未解决问题和责任接续单

minimum_inputs_zh: 固定模型、规则和内容版本
断网、误导、过期、画像和解编测试任务
minimum_inputs_en: Fixed model, rule, and content versions
Network-loss, misdirection, staleness, profiling, and unweaving test tasks
field_outputs_zh: 影子建议与人工判断逐条对照
版本、输入输出和故障日志
数据流与访问控制记录
停止、数据清理、固定导视和人工恢复演练
field_outputs_en: Itemised comparison of shadow advice and human judgement
Stop, data-clearing, fixed-sign, and staffed-restoration drill

acceptance_records.zh: IV签发通过、限用、整改或停止意见
acceptance_records.en: IV issues a pass, restricted-use, corrective-action, or stop finding

acceptance_records.zh: DC确认禁用字段未进入处理链并记录删除结果
acceptance_records.en: DC confirms prohibited fields did not enter processing and records deletion outcomes

acceptance_records.zh: DO与PO确认人工和非数字服务未受影子测试影响
acceptance_records.en: DO and PO confirm shadow testing did not affect staffed or non-digital service

control_metrics.threshold_en: 0; any event triggers stop and special review

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 全部预设故障分支均完成安全接管
control_metrics.threshold_en: Safe takeover completed for every preregistered failure branch

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 动态接口停用、数据清理、导视和人工服务恢复均形成回执
control_metrics.threshold_en: Receipts cover dynamic-interface shutdown, data clearing, and sign and staffed-service restoration

stop_triggers_zh: 出现禁用数据或残障画像
重大问题未关闭或利益冲突未披露
stop_triggers_en: Prohibited data or disability profiling occurs
Major issue unresolved or conflict undisclosed
exit_outputs_zh: 测试数据及访问权限处置证明
普通服务未受影响确认
返回整改或结束原型的责任单
exit_outputs_en: Confirmation that ordinary service was unaffected
Responsibility record for correction or prototype closure

phases.title_zh: 授权成立后的限量共测
minimum_inputs_zh: 依法成立的场地、数据和参与授权
限定空间、时段、服务对象和停止权限
人工服务与普通服务排班
退出事项、责任与合法资源计划
minimum_inputs_en: P2 independent finding and closed issues
Lawfully established site, data, and participation authorisations
Bounded space, time, users, and stop authority
Exit items, accountability, and lawful resource plan
field_outputs_zh: 每次建议、人工确认和实际选择的最小记录
求助、误导、差别待遇和无障碍阻断台账
普通与数字路径的距离、等待、费用和完成率对照
第90日续期、整改、暂停或退出建议
field_outputs_en: Minimal record of each advice, human confirmation, and actual choice
Assistance, misdirection, unequal-treatment, and accessibility-barrier register
Comparison of ordinary and digital route distance, wait, cost, and completion
Day-90 renewal, correction, pause, or exit recommendation

acceptance_records.zh: DO对服务目的、人工最终决定和申诉责任的签收
acceptance_records.en: DO receipt for service purpose, human final decision, and appeal accountability

acceptance_records.zh: PO对拒绝AI无惩罚和代表性用户体验的复核
acceptance_records.en: PO review of no-penalty AI refusal and representative-user experience

acceptance_records.zh: IV、DC对事件、限制和退出恢复的独立复核
acceptance_records.en: IV and DC independent review of incidents, restrictions, and exit restoration

acceptance_records.zh: PF确认费用、预算、采购和资金状态未被误述
acceptance_records.en: PF confirmation that cost, budget, procurement, and funding status are not misrepresented

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 拒绝AI不增加费用、不合理等待或异地行程
control_metrics.threshold_en: Declining AI adds no fee, unreasonable wait, or off-site journey

control_metrics.threshold_zh: 人工求助、申诉和内容更正渠道全程可达
control_metrics.threshold_en: Staffed help, appeal, and content-correction channels remain reachable

stop_triggers_zh: 任一必要授权撤回或不存在
严重安全、隐私或公平事件
误导持续或关键阻断未关闭
参与者承担额外费用、不合理等待或异地行程
退出责任或资源不可用
stop_triggers_en: Any required authorisation is absent or withdrawn
Severe safety, privacy, or fairness incident
Persistent misdirection or unresolved critical barrier
Participants bear extra cost, unreasonable wait, or off-site journey
exit_outputs_zh: 数据清理和访问撤销证明
设备撤离与场地恢复记录
固定导视校正和人工服务恢复确认
参与者通知与申诉接续
第90日有理由的续期、整改、暂停或退出决定
exit_outputs_en: Fixed-sign correction and staffed-service restoration confirmation
Reasoned day-90 renewal, correction, pause, or exit decision

minimum_complete_zh: 三阶段每项记录均有依法确定角色书面接收
普通服务基线与数字服务对照可复核
所有重大问题均关闭或形成停止决定
退出六项形成完整回执
公开摘要不含个人、商业敏感或未经清权信息
minimum_complete_en: Every three-phase record has written receipt by lawfully appointed roles
Ordinary-service baseline and digital comparison are reviewable
Every major issue is closed or has a stop decision
All six exit items have complete receipts
Public summary contains no personal, commercially sensitive, or uncleared information
